root: ^Oh, a pirate's life is the life for me!
^Hello, sir... I don't think it is safe.
^A young lady? What are you doing here, the show did not started yet!
^Tweedle Dee was looking for his brother and I am pretty sure that's him... He's worried sick, sir!
^And how can you be so sure it is him?
^He said they look the same, but different...
^She's right, Dodo! I am Tweedle Dum and I am not a part of your knife throwing act!
^Well, my cards dissapeared and if I have no cards to throw my knives at, then you are the best alternative!
^I can help you find your cards, sir...
^Oh, is that so? Such a kind lady you are!
^Forward, backward, inward outward, come and join the chase...!
